_summary.headline: Of ~12 FORM-A backlog anchors, ~7 have a HARD_PASS cell to author from (within-domain analogy, counterfactual, audit-preserving, deletion-cert, drift-kappa3, composition-L10000, eviction-B6); 4 hold/caution (cross-domain RETRACTED, multi-hop contested, pattern-completion formula-only, hierarchical-5corpus no-clean-run); 1 no-cell (Mode-4 NC1).
_summary.TYPE_finding: 4+ of the audit primitives are NOT capability-accuracies -- they are correctness (deletion-cert), ratio (drift-kappa3), aggregate (composition), comparative (eviction-B6) metrics. FORM-A authoring must type-verify and represent each correctly (NOT as accuracy-lifts) -- same EM-class discipline that caught EM 1.0.
_summary.discipline_caveat: This is cell-NAME+verdict triage. Per the TIER-1 lesson (phase4b_collins_ab name != SVAMP content), each anchor requires its specific write_metrics READ + type-verify before authoring. Triage = candidate identification, NOT authorability confirmation.
_summary.recommended_order: author the 3 capability-type candidates first (within-domain analogy, counterfactual, audit-preserving) as cleanest; then the 4 type-flagged audit primitives with correct provenance-type; hold the 4; drop/defer Mode-4.
